outcome: RSV infection characteristics (seasonal presentation, age affected, health status)
Clinical manifestations of RSV (cough, fever, rhinorrhea, respiratory distress)
Primary diagnoses (bronchiolitis, obstructive bronchial syndrome, influenza-like illness)
Caregiver work absence due to child's illness
cohort: 102 children under 5 years of age diagnosed with acute respiratory infection due to RSV and attended on an outpatient basis at a public pediatric hospital.
finding: Outpatient RSV infection presented seasonally, primarily affecting healthy children aged 13-24 months, with bronchiolitis being the most common diagnosis.
